workspaceId.description: The workspace. If you do not send it, the server uses the workspace of the session.

query.description: The work that you are about to do, in free text. If you do not send a query, the server uses the scope as the query.

scope.description: Only facts about this repository path, team or project.

tokenBudget.description: The maximum number of tokens in the pack. The default is 2000. The server changes a value above 20000 to 20000.

moduleIds.description: The modules of the work. Knowledge about them, and about their neighbour modules, goes to the top.

issueId.description: The issue of the work. Its modules and its capability set the order.
